about: An application opens the platform's Settings at a page (docs/adr/0019-settings.mdx), as a Mac's application opens x-apple.systempreferences: React Native's Linking opens oxyos-settings://about, which the application asks of the session from its window, citing the press; the session opens it in Settings, whose entry declares the scheme, and Linking resolves. Any other URL (https://example.com) is still refused, saying why, and nothing is opened. With the compositor refusing an application's OpenUrl, the Settings step closes the application's connection and fails.

steps.name: Open the web first: refused, saying why; nothing is opened

texts_matching: ^refused: OxyOS has no application that opens https links yet

steps.name: Open Settings: the session opens oxyos-settings://about in Settings, at its About page, and Linking resolves
